Checkpoints and `requirements.txt` live next to `pixi.toml`, not inside the package directory.

The notebooks export into `solid_lens/`, so a module's `__file__` is not the top of the repo. Checkpoints, the character dictionary, and `requirements.txt` stay next to `pixi.toml`. Call [`repo_root`](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/core.html#repo_root) instead of assuming where the file lives. In a notebook there is no `__file__`, so the search also starts from the working directory.

### repo_root

```python
def repo_root()->Path:
```

*Checkout that holds `models/`, `pixi.toml`, and `requirements.txt`.*
:::


[`repo_root`](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/core.html#repo_root) is the directory you clone, not the package directory inside it.

::: {#66e72f729f20 .cell quarto-private-1='{"key":"execution","value":{"iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-05T17:44:16.192329+00:00","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-05T17:44:16.200417+00:00","total":0.008091751486063004}}' execution_count=5}
``` {.python .cell-code}
from fastcore.test import test_eq

root = repo_root()
test_eq(root.name, "solid_lens")
test_eq((root / "pixi.toml").is_file(), True)
test_eq((root / "nbs").is_dir(), True)
root.name
```
